beats.say: Minecraft is the best-selling video game of all time.
Over 400 million copies sold, that is more than the entire population of the UK.
It started on 17 May 2009, with one person coding in Java.
Markus Notch Persson built it alone, before Mojang Studios even existed.
The world is infinite, made of blocks you can break and build.
Now, a movie is in cinemas, but it began with a single coder.
That was Player One, subscribe so you don't miss the next one. Minecraft is the best-selling video game of all time.

facts: Minecraft is the best-selling video game of all time with over 400 million copies sold.
Minecraft had its initial public alpha release on 17 May 2009.
The game was originally created by Markus Notch Persson using Java.
Players explore a procedurally generated world with virtually infinite terrain made of blocks.
A film adaptation titled A Minecraft Movie was released in 2025.
